title: Strengthening Long-term Healthcare Workforce Sustainability while Maintaining Care Standards
what_it_is: Strengthening Long-term Healthcare Workforce Sustainability while Maintaining Care Standards

sections.label: Healthcare workforce sustainability strategy
sections.summary: Singapore adopts a multi-pronged workforce strategy, builds local healthcare workforce, recruits foreign workers, and diversifies recruitment sources with bilateral agreements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health in light of global competition and rising domestic demand for healthcare manpower (a) how Singapore is strengthening long-term workforce sustainability while maintaining care standards; and (b) whether workforce planning assumptions are being reviewed to ensure resilience amid tightening regional labour markets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We adopt a multi-pronged workforce strategy to ensure sufficient healthcare manpower while maintaining care standards and regularly update our plans as circumstances change.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our focus continues to be to build up the local core of our healthcare workforce through diversifying training pathways, increasing local intakes for healthcare programmes and ensuring that job roles are attractive and salaries are competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We bring in qualified foreign healthcare workers in areas of shortfall.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: And to ensure resilience, we diversify the sources of foreign recruitment and secure government-to-government bilateral manpower cooperation agreements with regional countries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will continue to invest in good preventive health and right-site patients to appropriate care settings to keep our healthcare system sustainable.

sections.label: Foreign domestic workers in Singapore
sections.summary: Singapore has 300,000 foreign domestic workers, about one-fifth of the foreign workforce, many caring for seniors at home.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I have a question regarding foreign domestic workers in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I understand we have 300,000 foreign domestic workers who form about one-fifth of our foreign workforce.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Many of them work in the homes in the care settings at home, taking care of seniors with a range of conditions as well, some more severe than others.

sections.label: Foreign domestic workers care progression
sections.summary: The question asks whether foreign domestic workers can progress to community care sector care staff or nurse roles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Do we have options for these foreign domestic workers to progress to also join the community care sector as a care staff, or even nurses as well?
